items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And I had this Sandman with me that was on the tour with Basie with me and Tommy Tucker

ctx.x: And I had this Sandman with me that was on the tour with Basie with me and Tommy Tucker, blues singer, and I had Elaine, the girl had kind of a hit record, that was like -- what was her name? She was doing good with a record. Had a big show. I put this show together.
